title: Same Job Same Pay orders for labour hire
summary: The Fair Work Commission can order labour-hire providers to pay at least the host's enterprise agreement rates; provisions commenced 15 December 2023 and orders operate from 1 November 2024.

instruments.title: Fair Work Legislation Amendment (Closing Loopholes) Act 2023

commenced.what: Provisions commenced; applications could be made

direction_rationale: Higher minimum rates for labour hire raise its cost and reduce flexibility for hosts, limiting a channel used by entrants and contractors.
comparison: Hosts named in orders versus others; small-business hosts exempt

verified.notes: Dates from the Fair Work Commission's guide to the Closing Loopholes Acts.
